notes.subject: כי
notes.rationale: Hebrew כי here justifies the clause; no single Guarani word carries it, so it is folded into the sentence flow.

notes.subject: גבורי חיל
notes.rationale: literally 'powerful ones of force/valour'; rendered as one quality phrase ipu'akapaitéva rather than two nouns.

notes.subject: narrative continuation
notes.rationale: Verse continues the list addressed to the exilic reader of Chronicles, describing who came to David.

translation: Ha umíva oipytyvõ David rehe hoko'ãme, ⟨את⟩ pe aty ñorãirõhára ári, che ñe'ẽme'ẽ ndaipóri — upéicharamo jepe, ha'e kuera oipytyvõ David-pe pe ñorãirõ aty rehe, umi ipu'akapaitéva apytépegui, opaite ha'e kuéra, ha oiko chuguéra ikatuha va'ekue ñorãirõhára atýpe.
